e.title: glmmnet
e.summary: 精算应用中的高基数类别特征机器学习（GLMM+lasso）：UNSW agi-lab 论文代码
e.body: glmmnet 是 UNSW agi-lab 论文《Machine Learning with High-Cardinality Categorical Features in Actuarial Applications》的代码：处理精算数据中高基数类别特征（如邮编、车型、职业）的机器学习方法——GLMM 与 lasso/elastic net 结合。高基数类别特征是车险/家财险定价的实际痛点（因子表粒度 vs 过拟合）。关联 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-nam]]、[[insurancerating]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：UNSW agi-lab，论文《ML with High-Cardinality Categorical Features in Actuarial Applications》代码，UNSW Actuarial Software Directory 收录
e.summary_en: Machine learning with high-cardinality categorical features in actuarial applications (GLMM + lasso): UNSW agi-lab paper code
e.summary_hk: 精算應用中的高基數類別特徵機器學習（GLMM+lasso）：UNSW agi-lab 論文代碼
e.body_en: glmmnet is the code of the UNSW agi-lab paper 'Machine Learning with High-Cardinality Categorical Features in Actuarial Applications': machine-learning methods for high-cardinality categorical features in actuarial data (e.g. postcode, vehicle type, occupation) — combining GLMM with lasso/elastic net. High-cardinality categoricals are a real pain point in motor/home pricing (factor-table granularity vs overfitting). Related: [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuarial-nam]], [[insurancerating]], [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: glmmnet 是 UNSW agi-lab 論文《Machine Learning with High-Cardinality Categorical Features in Actuarial Applications》的代碼：處理精算數據中高基數類別特徵（如郵編、車型、職業）的機器學習方法——GLMM 與 lasso/elastic net 結合。高基數類別特徵是車險/家財險定價的實際痛點（因子表粒度 vs 過擬合）。關聯 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-nam]]、[[insurancerating]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]。
